summary: BP PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting its first quarter 2026 earnings. The filing contains financial results and operational updates, including a mention of an agreement to sell the Gelsenkirchen refinery and plans to reduce corporate hybrid bond financing. No specific deal terms, price per share, or premium are stated. The filing is a routine earnings report and does not constitute a special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. It is a standard periodic disclosure by a foreign issuer.
